films.title: FOR YOU
films.description: Astray's 19-minute full-length was filmed entirely in Barcelona by Pris Pietroboni. The uninterrupted film closes with a 23-rider credit roll documenting the crew and friends represented across the project.
creditNotes: The complete authorized upload supplies the uninterrupted film and its 23-name closing credit roll; rider spellings preserve the published end cards.
Skate Jawn independently identifies the project as Astray's Barcelona full-length and credits Pris Pietroboni with filming.
No riders are inferred from appearance alone; the roster is limited to names in the film's formal credit roll.
films.locationNote: Both the first-party upload and Skate Jawn state that the full-length was filmed entirely in Barcelona.
films.historicalContext: FOR YOU preserves a contemporary Barcelona-based crew document with a formal closing roster broad enough to capture the local and visiting skaters who shaped the production.
films.artworkNotes: The exact authorized upload's 480x360 YouTube artwork was visually reviewed on 2026-09-16. It shows a fisheye street-skating frame at a sunlit Barcelona spot and contains no trailer, episode or compilation labeling.

films.title: WARM ONE
films.description: Will Lloyd's sixth full skate video collects nearly two and a half years of filming across Arkansas, Texas and Missouri. The 27-minute independent full-length formally spotlights complete parts from Jake Bowman and Todd Given while retaining the broader montage crew as unnamed rather than inventing credits.
creditNotes: Will Lloyd's first-party description identifies WARM ONE as his sixth full skate video and formally names full parts from Jake Bowman and Todd Given.

The upload says the film also features the wider crew, old and new, while Skate Jawn says 'many more'; because neither publishes those names, only the two formally named full-part riders are promoted into the roster.
Skate Jawn independently corroborates Will Lloyd's authorship, the project's full-length status and its Arkansas, Texas and Missouri production footprint.
films.locationNote: The first-party description specifically names Austin, St. Louis and Kansas City; Skate Jawn independently broadens the documented footprint to Arkansas, Texas and Missouri.
films.historicalContext: Released on Go Skateboarding Day 2026, WARM ONE extends Will Lloyd's long-running independent video series with a multi-state regional document built patiently over nearly two and a half years.
films.artworkNotes: The exact authorized upload's 1280x720 YouTube artwork was visually reviewed on 2026-09-16. It shows two skaters celebrating beside a yellow curb and contains no trailer, episode or compilation labeling.

films.title: NOWT DAFT
films.description: Myles Rushforth's 33-minute South Yorkshire scene video joins Barnsley and Sheffield across eight documented riders. Rushforth filmed and edited the project, whose chaptered structure closes with an Eamon Samojlow tribute and credits.
creditNotes: The filmmaker's complete upload names all eight riders in its description and chapter list and explicitly credits Myles Rushforth with filming and editing.
SkateVideoSite independently classifies NOWT DAFT as a 33-minute 2026 full-length and corroborates the complete eight-rider roster and Myles Rushforth's filmmaking credit.
Route One independently describes the project as a South Yorkshire scene video and a labor of love showcasing skateboarding across Sheffield and Barnsley.
films.locationNote: The first-party title treatment identifies a Barnsley / Sheffield skateboard video, and Route One independently corroborates both South Yorkshire locations.
films.historicalContext: NOWT DAFT is Myles Rushforth's fifth scene-video offering and a contemporary record of connected generations of skateboarders across Barnsley and Sheffield.
films.artworkNotes: The exact authorized upload's 1280x720 YouTube artwork was visually reviewed on 2026-09-16. It shows a skater clearing a gap between metal utility housings beneath a dedicated NOWT DAFT / A BARNSLEY SHEFFIELD SKATEBOARD VIDEO title treatment, with no trailer or episode labeling.
